name: v1.8.8
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: upgrade undici to 7.29.0, 8.9.0 (CVE-2026-13697) by @anupamme in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2326
* fix: sync package-lock with undici 7.29.0 bump by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2361
* docs: fix broken star history chart by @OctoBored in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2301
* fix(weixin): recover draft cover uploads by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2362
* feat(bilibili): add --top to fetch pinned comments by @henrycjchen in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2106
* fix(xiaohongshu): harvest search rows during scroll instead of first/last screen union by @sleepyy-dog in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2349
* refactor(sinafinance): use rolling news API by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2365
* chore(xiaohongshu): share evaluate unwrap helper by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2363
* feat(zhihu): preserve comment reply threads by @wuyak in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2306
* feat(zhihu): export answers with local images by @wuyak in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2304
* fix(xiaohongshu): recover from collapsed masonry render by reopening in a fresh tab by @sleepyy-dog in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2355
* feat(jira): add custom field support by @du00cs in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2289
* feat(minimax): add music-generation adapter with global and China endpoints by @octo-patch in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2290
* feat(bilibili): add creator analytics adapter by @ele-yufo in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2268
* feat(xiaohongshu): add search filter panel options (--sort/--note-type/--publish-time/--scope/--location) by @xemaya in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2276
* feat(twitter): intercept complete followers timeline by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2380
* fix(notebooklm): support redirected domain by @lingjiuu in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2228
* fix: declare the Node >=20.18.1 floor that undici 7.x already requires by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2381
* fix(twitter): read current following follower counts by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2382
* feat(xiaoyuzhou): add playback history by @lmmsoft in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2260
* fix(jike): reject anonymous read sessions by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2384
* feat(execution): support OPENCLI_SITE_SESSION env default for adapter site sessions by @GabrielDrapor in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2221
* feat(youtube): paginate authenticated watch history by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2386
* fix(youtube): paginate search results by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2387
* fix(midjourney): always poll job history at least once before timing out by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2383
* chore: npm audit fix for dev-dependency advisories by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2378
* feat(pixiv): add novel commands by @b1llow in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2112
* fix(trip): repair flight extraction — dropped font-black class emptied every row by @yisiliu in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2385
* fix(nowcoder): distinguish content and moment posts by @aolast in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2218
* fix(ctrip): read structured flight results by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2393
* feat(jike): use structured APIs for search and notifications by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2394
* fix(linkedin): make sent invitations and thread snapshots accurate by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2395
* docs(skill): add evidence-first Deep Recon workflow by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2398
* feat(gmail): add browser-backed Gmail adapter by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2396
* fix(output): keep markdown rows intact for multi-line cells by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2375
* fix(browser): preserve structured network captures by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2406
* chore: shrink convention-audit baselines to current findings by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2377
* chore(pack): exclude test files and fixtures from npm package by @bytemain in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2410
* chore(pack): prune @mixmark-io/domino's vendored test suite on install by @bytemain in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2411
* feat(dribbble): add browser adapter commands by @jiejia in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2403
* fix(dribbble): distinguish empty states from selector drift by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2423
* fix(pipeline): reject invalid concurrency limits by @hiSandog in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2407
* fix(runtime): honor OPENCLI_CDP_ENDPOINT for web adapters by @axxop in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2148
* fix(errors): duck-typing for cross-package CliError in toEnvelope by @omnisurge in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2388
* fix(xiaohongshu): retry once through a cooldown on risk-control soft blocks (#1825) by @LeoLin990405 in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2207
* fix(linux-do): use current session for whoami by @zhuxiucai in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2397
* fix(xiaohongshu): stop ask breaking on webpack chunk renumbering, and stop it spending a note search per call by @vecyang1 in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2420
* harden: sanitize child_process call in spotify.js... by @anupamme in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2318
* chore: release v1.8.8 by @jackwener in https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI/pull/2440
